source_review.notes: Checked all eight references for identity, authority, revision status, and bounded claim scope. Official OpenTelemetry pages support the stable Logs Data Model in specification 1.60.0, legacy integration approach, fields, correlation, and event guidance; Semantic Conventions 1.44.0 event guidance is explicitly labeled Development. IETF RFC 5424 supports syslog structure, framing, timing, truncation, and congestion claims. RFC 8259 supports JSON encoding, UTF-8, and duplicate-name cautions. Current OWASP logging guidance supports data exclusion, injection, verification, protection, and lifecycle claims. NIST SP 800-92 is identified as the 2006 final guide while its current project page describes Revision 1 as draft. Google SRE supports logging as diagnostic evidence. Checked 2026-09-06.
